Millions of Americans get care at home every year. The agencies delivering it run on decades-old software, disconnected tools, phone calls, and faxes, with nothing that ties the work together.

 - You've worked at a startup and can decide what to do without a spec.

 - Product sense: you listen closely to users, go deep on their problems, and translate what they need into the right technical decisions.

 - You've built something people depended on, where getting it wrong had real consequences.
   
   

Bonus

 - Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HL7/FHIR).
